map_features.note: Direct current observations around 5°N, 23°W; not a basin-wide path or length endpoint.
map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: Declared western-to-central Atlantic subsurface reference reach between observations at 35 W near 5 N and the central observational neighborhood at 23 W near 5 N. Connecting vertices are editorial, not an observed continuous axis. Excludes NBC/NEC source recirculation, surface NECC flow, uncertain filaments east of 28 W and farther-east termination. Not full-current source-to-end length.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

widths.boundary_rule: Author reports a two-degree latitude width centered at 5 N. Lateral velocity threshold unspecified; no threshold or observed edge coordinates inferred.
widths.extraction_method: Source angular width transcribed; WGS84 meridional unit conversion centered at reported latitude, rounded to 10 km. Normalization limits are computation only, not observed edges; no source figure digitized.
widths.geographic_scope: 35 W section near 5 N; reported latitude width for this historical survey. Not a uniform along-route width.
widths.layer: Historical subsurface NEUC velocity-core context near sigma-theta 26.75 kg/m3; full width at every depth and fixed-depth bounds unresolved.
widths.name: Atlantic North Equatorial Undercurrent
widths.range_interpretation: Published approximate two-degree latitude span, converted to kilometres; no source uncertainty range and no annual/seasonal variability interval.
remaining_gates: Independent scientific extraction review and canonical admission.
Diagnose lateral boundaries and compatible repeated sections before full-width or seasonal dimensions.
widths.section_orientation: Reported meridional section span; no exact flow-normal reinterpretation or observed paired-edge geometry.
widths.source_citation: Bourles, Gouriou and Chuchla (1999), On the circulation in the upper layer of the western equatorial Atlantic, JGR Oceans 104(C9), 21151–21170, doi:10.1029/1999JC900058.
widths.source_locator: Section 4.8, p. 21163: 35 W sections in February 1993 and April 1996, centered at 5 N with two-degree latitude width; Figs. 3c and 3e.
widths.time_convention: February 1993 source section; month precision only, exact occupation days unresolved. Not a seasonal climatology.
